title: SL(2,3) / Gauge Prime / E6 Unification

core_result.statement: The Heisenberg group Heis(F_3) = 3^(1+2) of order 27 is canonically the unique Sylow-3 subgroup of the Hessian group = F_3^2 : SL(2,3), which in turn is a subgroup of W(E6). This embeds the W(3,3) gauge structure into the McKay E6 framework.
core_result.proof: Hessian = F_3^2 : SL(2,3). Sylow-3 of SL(2,3) = Z_3 (generated by unipotent U=[[1,1],[0,1]]). Sylow-3 of Hessian = F_3^2 extended by Z_3 acting via U = upper triangular unipotent = Heisenberg extension = Heis(F_3). QED.
